Troubleshooting · 26/50 · delivery

Container metadata incomplete

Failure signal

A container metadata incomplete condition is reported or detected during delivery.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for delivery does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Validate language, track order, timebase, field dominance and descriptive tags.

Corrective action

Rewrite metadata without altering essence where possible, then revalidate the container.

Prevention

Add this verification to the delivery gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
